job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Prompt Engineer with 5+ years of overall experience and deep expertise in designing, optimizing, and evaluating prompts for Large Language Models (LLMs). The ideal candidate will work closely with AI/ML engineers, data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to build reliable, scalable, and high-quality Generative AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and optimize high-quality prompts for LLMs (e.g., GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama) across multiple use cases
Engineer prompt strategies including few-shot, chain-of-thought, role-based, and structured prompting
Collaborate with ML engineers to integrate prompts into RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines
Fine-tune and evaluate prompt performance based on accuracy, relevance, hallucination reduction, and token efficiency
Develop prompt versions for multi-turn conversations and agent-based workflows
Create reusable prompt templates and prompt libraries for enterprise use
Perform prompt evaluation using quantitative and qualitative metrics
Work with domain experts (BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, etc.) to align prompts to business context
Ensure prompts adhere to responsible AI, data privacy, and security standards
Document prompt design principles, testing results, and best practices
Stay updated with the latest advancements in LLMs, GenAI frameworks, and prompt engineering techniques

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

5+ years of experience in AI, NLP, ML, or related fields
Strong hands-on experience with Prompt Engineering for LLMs
Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI, etc.)
Solid understanding of NLP concepts, transformers, embeddings, and tokenization
Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate)
Proficiency in Python and familiarity with LangChain / LlamaIndex / Semantic Kernel
Knowledge of prompt evaluation frameworks and hallucination mitigation techniques



Domain & Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to translate business requirements into effective prompt designs
Excellent communication and documentation skills
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Stakeholder management and collaboration skills

Good to Have

Experience in BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, or Enterprise SaaS domains
Exposure to AI agents, tools/function calling, and workflow orchestration
Understanding of LLM fine-tuning and parameter-efficient training (LoRA, adapters)
Experience with multi-modal models (text, image, audio)
Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks and compliance standards

Education

Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field

What We Offer

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge Generative AI solutions
High-impact role with business and technical visibility
Learning and certification support for AI/ML advancements
Competitive compensation and flexible work options

If you want, I can also:

Tailor this JD for BFSI / Product / Consulting domain
Create a short recruiter version
Convert it to a client-ready or portal-friendly format
